title: Sharplink thesis
description: A long statement on black that stays pinned while its words light up one by one as you scroll, then fades and rises away as a huge arc of blue opens beneath it and turns to pale paper; below, a list of points (line icon, title, grey text) between dotted rules fades in beside a large media slot.
notes: the top stage uses the theme's dark colours (.dark); the list below is on the light paper (transparent: on the page it shows the Sharplink backdrop)
the big media slot is shown on wide screens only; empty, it is a faint placeholder
CSS only: a sticky statement driven by the stage's named view timeline; without support or with reduced motion the statement is simply there
